en.title: Magic: The Gathering Conjures Marvel's Darkhold Destiny: Preorders Now Live
en.summary: Prepare for a supernatural showdown as Magic: The Gathering unveils its next major Marvel collaboration, 'Marvel: Darkhold Destiny.' Preorders for this highly anticipated set, featuring an original story and iconic Marvel characters, are officially open.
en.body:
The multiverse just got a whole lot darker. Wizards of the Coast has officially lifted the veil on **Magic: The Gathering's** next massive crossover: **Marvel: Darkhold Destiny**. Set to launch on April 9, 2027, this expansion plunges players deep into the mystical and monstrous side of the Marvel Universe, and preorders are available right now.

This isn't just another skin-deep crossover; **Marvel: Darkhold Destiny** boasts an entirely original narrative crafted in collaboration with Marvel itself. The story centers on the sinister **Darkhold**, an artifact of immense power that the world's greatest sorcerers attempted to seal away. Naturally, their efforts failed, unleashing a torrent of supernatural threats. Expect to encounter devils, sorcerers, and even vampire-hunting vampires as the set explores the shadowy depths of Marvel's supernatural pantheon. The narrative will unfold across the cards and is also being adapted into a special Marvel Comics release, penned by acclaimed writers **Jackson Lanzing** and **Collin Kelly**, due in February 2027.

"This story was crafted by our Narrative team with Magic in mind, and we're thrilled to see it adapted by two of Marvel's most beloved writers," stated Wizards of the Coast. "You'll be able to follow this dimension-hopping narrative across the set, all while uncovering the secrets of the Dark Dimension and joining forces with Marvel's pantheon of gods."

For dedicated **Magic: The Gathering** players and Marvel enthusiasts alike, **Marvel: Darkhold Destiny** represents a thrilling new frontier. The promise of exploring the supernatural elements of Marvel, from witches to werewolves, alongside a fresh, original story, is incredibly compelling. The inclusion of **Magik**, a mutant sorceress familiar to fans of *Marvel Rivals* and *Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls*, is just the tip of the iceberg. Wizards of the Coast has teased the arrival of numerous other "hotly anticipated" Marvel heroes and villains making their **Magic: The Gathering** debut. The set will also feature four distinct Commander decks and bundles, offering varied entry points for different playstyles.

## A Multiverse of Magic Awaits

The hype surrounding **Marvel: Darkhold Destiny** is palpable within the **Magic: The Gathering** community. Fans are eager to see how beloved Marvel characters and lore will be translated into the iconic gameplay mechanics of **Magic**. The focus on supernatural elements suggests a unique strategic landscape, potentially featuring powerful spells, dark rituals, and creature types that lean into horror and mysticism. The collaborative storytelling approach, bridging both the card game and a dedicated comic release, ensures a deep and immersive experience that caters to fans who appreciate rich lore and character development. This expansion promises to be a significant event, drawing in players who might be new to **Magic** but are passionate about the Marvel Universe.

## What's Next

**Marvel: Darkhold Destiny** officially releases on April 9, 2027. Preorders are currently live through local game stores, TCGplayer, Amazon, and other major retailers. The accompanying Marvel Comics adaptation is set for a digital release in February 2027, with a physical version following in April.

content_raw: Magic: The Gathering's next Marvel crossover set has been revealed , as Wizards of the Coast announced that "Marvel: Darkhold Destiny" will launch on April 9, 2027. Preorders are now available via local game stores, TCGplayer , Amazon , and other retailers. I'll leave links to where you can buy everything just below. "The world's greatest sorcerers conspired to keep the Darkhold sealed," Wizards of the Coast (WOTC) said in its announcement, as part of New York Comic Con. "But the dark side of the Marvel Universe has been unleashed!" It also teased the arrival of "devils, sorcerers, and vampire-hunting vampires" in the upcoming set, which will of course explore the supernatural side of Marvel. An original story has been developed for the new set, with WOTC developing in collaboration with Marvel, which will also introduce a brand-new original character. The story will also be adapted into a special Marvel Comics release, written by Jackson Lanzing and Collin Kelly. "This story was crafted by our Narrative team with Magic in mind, and we're thrilled to see it adapted by two of Marvel's most beloved writers," added WOTC. "You'll be able to follow this dimension-hopping narrative across the set, all while uncovering the secrets of the Dark Dimension and joining forces with Marvel's pantheon of gods." The comic is due to arrive in February 2027 in digital format, followed by a physical release in April. Magik, a mutant sorceress who many fans will also recognize from Marvel Rivals ' roster, or more recently Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls , is the only hero confirmed for the set so far. But WOTC has also said that the expansion will feature plenty more "hotly anticipated" Marvel heroes and villains making their MTG debuts. Marvel: Darkhold Destiny will include the main card set, Commander decks, Scene Boxes, and special collector-focused card designs. The Commander precon options this time around are Lords of Hel (red-black), Gods of Asgard (red-green-white), Strange Academy (white-blue-black) and Midnight Sons (white-black). WOTC says it has also developed new "Booster Fun treatments" for the expansion, alongside updated versions of designs used in previous releases, "so collectors of everything Marvel will have plenty to get excited for". Darkhold Destiny is one of the latest collaborations between Marvel and Magic: The Gathering, which has been increasingly drawing established entertainment franchises to the TCG through its Universes Beyond range. In 2025, we saw the Marvel Spider-Man set , and in 2026, we got the Marvel Super Heroes expansion as well. Now in 2027, Darkhold Destiny continues the longstanding collaboration between the entertainment giants.
